title: Supporting data and code for Sensitivity of hourly voltage decisions to charging energy representations in distribution test feeders
description:
Supporting data and code for the manuscript Sensitivity of hourly voltage decisions to charging energy representations in distribution test feeders by Mingming Dong, Ge Chen and Wei Chen.

Includes paired estimated hourly charging-energy inputs for 4,344 hours and 275 zones, synthetic mappings for 33-bus and 69-bus feeders, all 188 saved scenario arrays, analysis scripts, source data for manuscript figures and tables, pinned provenance, and SHA-256 verification. The frozen analysis includes 108 original and 80 extension scenarios. See README.md and REPRODUCING.md for scope and executable reproduction instructions.
